title: Bitwise AND of Numbers Range
statement_short: Given two integers left and right that represent the range [left, right], return the bitwise AND of all numbers in this range, inclusive.
hint: Large range up to 2^31 - 1 forbids linear iteration, requiring finding the common binary prefix of left and right.
why_not: Right: Bit Manipulation shifts left and right rightward until they match, finding the common binary prefix in O(1) time (max 32 shifts). Not Math / Geometry: Range summation formulas do not solve bitwise AND logic across consecutive integers. Not Two Pointers: Scanning numbers between left and right directly causes TLE when (right - left) reaches 2^31\. Not 1D DP: Range state caching is unneeded because matching highest bits determines the resulting prefix.
